periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with vertical elongation; width-to-height ratio approximately 0.75:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward extension where the patch centroid is displaced toward the lower lateral muzzle area.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve at the posterior margin where the black band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, comprising roughly 40% of the visible torso height from the shoulder to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant gap, approximately equal to the horizontal diameter of one eye patch.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex, and perfectly rounded curvature along the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-brown discoloration on the white pelage of the posterior lumbar region.
